title: Skin Care for Cricket Players: Sunscreen, Sweat and an After-Match Routine
ex: Long hours in the sun, sweat under helmets and dusty grounds: a simple before, during and after routine for people who play cricket in India.
rt: Skin Care for Cricket Players: Sun and Sweat | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for cricket players in India: water-resistant sunscreen, when to reapply at drinks breaks, helmet sweat bumps, a kit bag list and after-match care.
quick: Apply a broad-spectrum, water-resistant SPF 30+ sunscreen 15 minutes before play, reapply at every drinks or innings break, and do not miss ears, neck and nose. After the match, wash gently within an hour, cool hot skin and moisturise; skip strong actives on sunburnt skin.
facts: Reapply sunscreen about every 2 hours or at each break
Ears, neck, nose and lips are often missed
Wash helmet liners and caps often
Skip actives on sunburnt or stinging skin
